text:
laura-sales: FYI we just got a 240-question SIG/CAIQ from Helio Logistics. They want the questionnaire back + a POC environment for data routing by next Tue. Copy of spreadsheet: https://files.redwood.example/helio_sig.xlsx

julia-pss: can you flag which sections are blockers for the POC? encryption, network isolation, incident response, data residency usually are the ones I care about.

laura-sales: priority = encryption/KMS, VPC peering, audited access logs, and the SOC2 section. POC will need a sample S3 bucket + test webhook. Contact at Helio: ben@helio-logistics.com (Ben, infra lead).

mike-secops: taking ownership of the SIG draft. Plan: 1) triage and mark any answer that needs engineering or legal 2) draft responses for standard items 3) loop in eng for anything about runtime internals 4) hand to Tony for legal sign-off. ETA: initial triage in 24h, draft answers in 48h. Do we have an NDA?

laura-sales: NDA is signed and uploaded to the customer folder: https://files.redwood.example/helio_nda_signed.pdf :thumbsup:

tony-legal: confirmed, NDA signed by both parties. I can review any bespoke language if you surface it. For SIG we generally avoid new commitments beyond our standard security docs.

mike-secops: quick draft for Q: "Key management and encryption at rest" -> answer: "We support customer-controlled keys (BYOK) via KMS integrations. Redis/ephemeral caches do not persist keys. Redwood personnel do not have access to customer private keys. Detailed KMS integration steps will be provided in the POC runbook."

mike-secops: (snippet) ```KMS options: AWS KMS (customer key), GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault. BYOK enforced at the model-serving layer; keys never leave customer KMS.```

julia-pss: for the POC config, we'll need a minimal deployment example. Proposed command: `redwood deploy --env poc --model redwood-medium --vpc peered --kms customer-kms-id` — that should satisfy their infra team for testing basic isolation.

mike-secops: noted. Two potential blockers: 1) customer needs a peered VPC in same region (we can request peering but need their AWS account ID) 2) if they want on-prem private deployment for the POC we need infra lead in call.

laura-sales: Ben shared the AWS account and said he can do peering. I'll ask for the routing table snippet and send to you.

sig-bot: Triage ticket created: SR-4521 assigned to mike-secops. Deadline 48h.

mike-secops: after triage I'll put all draft answers in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.example/helio-sig-draft. Tony, I'll ping you for legal phrasing on any non-standard APIs.

tony-legal: will review once draft is up. If any question adds contractual obligations, flag it with `@tony-legal` and include proposed wording.

laura-sales: thanks — please highlight anything that will push POC past next Tue. I'm coordinating the schedule with Ben.

mike-secops: will do. Current plan keeps us on track for Tue unless eng needs to create a special VPC peering script. I'll update thread with blockers. :white_check_mark:
